newsitem.title: USA: Urocor Inc says names McDonald as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Urocor Inc says names McDonald as CFO.

text.p: UroCor Inc said Thursday that Michael McDonald had been named vice president and chief financial officer.
McDonald had served as director of finance and administration since 1994. He joined UroCor in 1992 as controller.

UroCor markets directly to urologists and managed care organizations a comprehensive range of integrated services for detecting, diagnosing and managing prostate cancer, bladder cancer, kidney stones and other complex urological disorders.
